tag: claims: Which stores took the most captured value last month?

facts: Ranked by captured payment value, highest first: Kloofmere Paarl has the highest captured payment value of the store groups ranked.
Store groups: 40 in total. Period: August 2026.
claims: During August 2026, Kloofmere Paarl achieved the highest captured payment value of R479,971, representing 4.9% of the total.
Kloofmere Midrand followed closely in second place with R413,153, while Kloofmere Knysna recorded the lowest among the listed stores at R293,155.
